name: Thallids
description: Creations of the elves of Havenwood who overthrew them and remained shambling brutes.

description_citations.text: "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elves turn to Thallid farming as the climate cools.
timeline.quote: As the climate cooled, many Elves turned to Thallid farming for food

citation.text: Elvish Hunter (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Morgan traps Loren with several Thallids to ensure his mission fails.
timeline.quote: Morgan having a long-standing family feud with Loren relishes this opportunity and traps Loren with several Thallids creatures.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 1: Rumors of War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tev destroys the Thallids with a Fireball but leaves, and Morgan kills Loren with a poisoned arrow.
timeline.quote: Tev moves on as Morgan strikes Loren down with a poisoned arrow killing him.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Volume 2: Nations Asunder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarpadia is plunged into chaos; the Ebon Hand is torn apart by a Thrull Rebellion and only thrulls and thallids remain.
timeline.quote: The Ebon Hand would be torn apart inside out by a Thrull Rebellion.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thelon creates the thallids by infusing fungus with green mana and borrowed dark rites.
timeline.quote: Thelon created the thallids by infusing natural fungus with green mana

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Thallids". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The thallids rebel against their creators and destroy their empire entirely.
timeline.quote: Eventually, they would rebel against their creators destroying their empire entirely.

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Thallids". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dwarven kingdom falls to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins, followed by the Ebon Hand falling to the thrulls and the elves to the thallids.
timeline.quote: starting with the fall of the dwarven kingdom to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
timeline.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai convinces thrulls to turn on their masters; they annihilate the Order and wipe out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia except the thallids; Jherana Rure is killed by thrull assassins.
timeline.quote: annihilating the Order and, save for the thallids , eventually wiping out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia.

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reod arranges a trade deal between the Ebon Hand and Havenwood that creates thallids, and is hired by the Elder Druids to distract Icatia.
timeline.quote: creating the thallids , a plentiful, if somewhat bland, food source

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reod's attempt to blow up the thallid farm fails and instills limited intelligence in the thallids; Sekena leaves with two whelps.
timeline.quote: instilling a limited form of intelligence in the thallids

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Havenwood Reod tries to blow up the elves' thallid farm, but it is protected from magic and two eggs hatch without exploding.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai tries to blow up the Thallid farm of the elves

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "To Havenwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Teedmar Reod and Eliza are ambushed by an Ebon Hand wizard, who reveals thallids have gained sentience and the Hand caused the volcano to erupt.
timeline.quote: they had caused the volcano near Teedmar to erupt, to kill the dwarves for selling weapons to Icatia

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Teedmar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Havenwood elves inadvertently create the thallids, which cause their extinction.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Sarpadian Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Thelon made the thallids from fungus and green mana.
